prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Finished full-color Japanese fantasy-comedy vertical webtoon segment, portrait about 1024x2048. Four unequal sequential panels, warm ivory #fffaf3 gutters, crisp anime linework and warm luminous cel shading. This is one segment of a long episode, not an entire episode.
LOCATION FIRST: a modest rural village of rough stone and timber houses, gardens, simple wooden fences and water buckets. NO palace halls, thrones, royal banners or marble terraces. Mira has visited the village; her royal clothes do not move everyone into a palace.
SCENE: 夜の窓で晴れ間が開き、城へ戻す手紙をミラが鳩へ結ぶ. Episode 20, strip 10.
ONLY permitted visible named cast: PR, PO. No other named character may be included.
Mira, adult blonde princess, partly braided hair, blue eyes, silver sapphire tiara, white and blue long gown, blue cloak, simple brown satchel. She wears the same clothes outdoors. Her reference palace is NOT the location of this scene.
Pochi, a compact natural orange Shiba, cream cheeks/chest/paws/eyebrow spots, brown eyes, curled tail, teal scarf ONE gold star. Four canine paws, no fingers. Dog human language is THOUGHT ONLY: cloud balloon dots attach ONLY to the dog head; humans never own his thoughts.
References establish identity/style ONLY; reject their background, poses, props and cast. Never add a reference character absent from the permitted cast. No magic, no teleporting, no future reveal. Low bypass carries a little water; high aqueduct remains closed until episode 27 small-flow tests and is closed again during repairs.
Choreography: ONLY the physical actions explicitly stated in SCENE. An observation is not a rescue or repair. Do not invent touching, lifting, fixing, giving tools or approaching danger. Requests for permission come before contact. Motion uses speed marks, never double heads or limbs. The dog remains quadrupedal, never human hands.
INTEGRATED EXACT JAPANESE lettering in art: upright VERTICAL glyphs, top to bottom, columns right to left. Large black manga gothic glyphs 65px or more at 1024px width, readable at 360px. Speech tails to the correct human, dog thoughts cloud with dots ONLY to dog. Do NOT transfer a dog thought to a human. Short supplied text ONLY, no invented dialogue/captions/headings/labels/English/watermark. Four camera beats top-to-bottom, unequal frame heights and widths, wide context then shallow detail, larger action, close reaction. Never four equal rectangles. Do not put everyone into every panel.
Panel 1: 場所と人物の位置を引きで示す。夜の窓で晴れ間が開き、城へ戻す手紙をミラが鳩へ結ぶ。まだ結末は見せない。
No speech or thought balloon in this panel.
Panel 2: 同じ場所で、行動を始める人物か手掛かりを寄りで示す。夜の窓で晴れ間が開き、城へ戻す手紙をミラが鳩へ結ぶ。
PR EXACT full text: 「村は無事です。」. Vertical columns RIGHT TO LEFT: 村は無事です / 。. Never print slash or speaker label. Spoken human words: tail to that person's mouth; do not use thought dots.
Panel 3: 前の観察を受け、次の動作を大きく見せる。夜の窓で晴れ間が開き、城へ戻す手紙をミラが鳩へ結ぶ。反応より先に原因と結果を見せる。
No speech or thought balloon in this panel.
Panel 4: 同じ場所で結果を受け止める表情や小さな動きを示す。夜の窓で晴れ間が開き、城へ戻す手紙をミラが鳩へ結ぶ。
PO内心 EXACT full text: 「向こうも待ってる。」. Vertical columns RIGHT TO LEFT: 向こうも待っ / てる。. Never print slash or speaker label. This is the DOG'S inner thought; dots connect ONLY to Pochi, NOT any human.
